body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. The target's next successful attack before your next turn ignores 1 point of ordinary Damage reduction, but not Resilience or Temporary Wounds.

surges.html: It ignores 1 point of cover bonus for that attack.
Its first hit enemy sheds light and loses ordinary darkness concealment until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Rite - Imbuement
rider.html: Rite, 2 Echoes: bind the target. Trigger: it hits an enemy in concealment. Echo: illuminate that enemy's space and reveal its location until your next turn.
